# Restaurant Guru

> > Restaurant Guru is a global restaurant discovery platform providing menus, prices, reviews, and ratings for local dining establishments worldwide.

Restaurant Guru helps users find restaurants near them with detailed information including Michelin ratings, user reviews, and menu details. The platform covers restaurants across multiple countries including Russia, the United States, and Turkey, offering multilingual support and mobile apps for personalized dining recommendations.

## Key Topics

- Restaurant reviews and ratings
- Restaurant menus and pricing
- Michelin Star and Bib Gourmand restaurants
- Local restaurant discovery
- Dining guides and recommendations
- Food delivery services
- Cafe and restaurant finder
- Permanently closed establishments tracking
- International cuisine types
- Mobile app for dining
- Yandex integration
- Regional restaurant coverage (Russia, USA, Turkey)
- User-generated reviews
- Travel and dining guides

## Restaurant Discovery & Search

- [Turkish Restaurant Finder Homepage](https://tr.restaurantguru.com/): Turkish-language homepage for discovering the best restaurants in 2026 near you
- [Restaurant Guru Mobile App](https://restaurantguru.com/app?hl=ru): Mobile application for personalized restaurant recommendations and dining discovery

## Restaurant Listings & Reviews

- [Шампур Cafe Menu - Barnaul](https://restaurantguru.com/Shampur-Barnaul/menu): Complete menu with prices and customer reviews for Шампур cafe in Barnaul, Russia
- [Pizza Chicago - Makhachkala](https://restaurantguru.com/Pizza-Chicago-Makhachkala): 5-star rated pizza restaurant in Makhachkala with delivery service, menu and pricing
- [Хинкал&Чуду - Surgut](https://restaurantguru.com/DagiandGreki-Surgut): Mediterranean restaurant in Surgut with menu and reviews (permanently closed)
- [Кинза Cafe - Ryazan](https://restaurantguru.com/Kinza-Ryazan): Cafe in Ryazan, Russia with historical menu and review information (permanently closed)
